contract.context_appid: Nonzero and equal to gameserver Utils.GetAppID(); false otherwise or if context cannot be verified.
contract.authid: 32-bit AccountID bits, public universe, individual account; zero rejected. Cannot recover caller-truncated SteamID64.
contract.client: Connected authorized human. Validated full SteamID must match validated AccountID and individual type; fallback from validated AccountID only if full ID is zero.
contract.request_success: Valid SteamAPICall_t; does not imply stats readiness.
contract.legacy_semantics: AppID is never universe; callers passing universe 1 must migrate to the real context AppID.

environments.isolation: Docker no network, repository read-only except .build
